newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Oporto repo market to open April 14.
newsitem.headline: Oporto repo market to open April 14.

text.p: A repo market will begin on Oporto Derivatives Exchange (BDP) on April 14, BDP managing director Alves Monteiro said.
"The repo market will start on April 14. There will be repos just in public debt," he told Reuters.
"The market will respond to the anxiety of international institutional investors who have difficulty taking positions in Portuguese debt," he added.
"We want Portuguese investment funds, which already have Portuguese bonds in their portfolios, to play a big role in this market," he said.
Alves Monteiro said he hoped turnover on the BDP would increase sharply after the opening of the repo market.
Futures on 10-year Portuguese government bonds and on the PSI20 .PSI20 index of 20 leading Portuguese shares are the only instruments now traded on the BDP.
